 The Vancouver Canucks (5-17-1) and Seattle Kraken (9-8-1) will meet in the NHL tonight. Puck drop is set for 9:40 p.m. EST at Climate Pledge Arena in Seattle, Wash. The game will broadcast live on ESPN+.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Kraken are favored at -170 on the moneyline, with the Canucks +140 to pull off the upset. The over/under is set at 6.5 (-108o / -112u).
 Let's get into our Canucks vs. Kraken predictions and NHL picks .
 Canucks vs. Kraken Prediction
 Pick: Vancouver Canucks ML 
 Our Vancouver vs. Seattle best bet is on the Canucks to win outright, with the best odds currently available at FanDuel. For all of your NHL bets, be sure to find the best lines by using our live NHL odds page. 
 Make sure to download the Action Network app for more NHL picks and analysis! 
 Canucks vs Kraken Odds
 Canucks vs. Kraken Puck Line: Kraken -1.5 (+148), Canucks +1.5 (-188)
 Canucks vs. Kraken Over/Under: 6.5 (-108o / -112u)
 Canucks vs. Kraken Moneyline: Canucks +140, Kraken -170
 Canucks vs. Kraken Best Bet: Canucks ML
 This will be the Kraken's first game back from Finland, and they couldn't leave that country fast enough.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement They were blown out by the defending Stanley Cup champion Hurricanes, after getting outscored 9-2 in two games.
 And you would think looking at the schedule, a "get-right game" would be against the Canucks right? Wrong!
 The Canucks have climbed out of the pit of misery they were in, by winning two in a row against the Golden Knights and the Mammoth.
 It seems as if coach Manny Malhotra has finally figured out that Kevin Lankinen is a bad goaltender and a big reason as to why this team has been a total disaster. Because Leevi Merilainen will start tonight in the Emerald City, against Seattle's Philipp Grubauer.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement And contrary to popular belief, Grubauer hasn't been a total disaster all season, playing to a serviceable .893 SV% and a -0.2 GSAx. A rapid improvement from what we're used to seeing from him.
 Seattle will continue to be a "blah" team for me. Its offense has never been good. The defense can hold its own. But even when the defense holds its own, the goaltending fails it.
 I knew that the Kraken were going to get blown out by the Canes. I correctly predicted that they would lose by at least two goals in each game, and now after a 10-hour trip back to the PNW, they have to face a Canucks team that's feeling their oats?
 Call me crazy, but I like Vancouver outright.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Best Bet: Vancouver Canucks ML
